description: This file defines functions and exports related to resolving status models, provider context tokens, and session classification within the openclaw project. It includes logic for handling model references, provider configurations, and session key types.

methods.name: resolveStatusModelRefFromRaw
methods.description: Resolves a model reference from raw input, considering aliases and configuration.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredStatusModelRef
methods.description: Determines the model reference for a given agent ID or defaults, with fallback.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredProviderContextTokens
methods.description: Finds context tokens for a provider and model based on configuration.

methods.name: classifySessionKey
methods.description: Classifies session keys into categories like global, group, or direct.

methods.name: resolveSessionModelRef
methods.description: Resolves the session's model reference, considering overrides and defaults.

methods.name: resolveContextTokensForModel
methods.description: Determines context tokens for a model, with override and fallback options.
